context: Checks whether the final artifact follows the plan-sprint instructions from the published agnostic-planning-skills tile.

checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Select tickets, define a goal, and commit to a sprint scope.

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Rule:** Don't overcommit — plan for ≤80% of theoretical capacity.

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Define sprint goal** — one sentence describing the sprint's outcome. Every selected ticket should support this goal.

checklist.name: instruction-4
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Select tickets** — start from the top of the backlog, stop when total estimate reaches ≤80% of capacity (see [Capacity Heuristics](#capacity-heuristics) below).

checklist.name: instruction-5
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Validate** — check no ticket has unresolved dependencies, unclear acceptance criteria, or missing estimates. Use the [Common Anti-Patterns](#common-anti-patterns) table as a checklist.

checklist.name: instruction-6
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Use when raw capacity or velocity data is unavailable or needs sanity-checking.

checklist.name: instruction-7
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **No history:** Use `theoretical_capacity × 0.6` as a conservative baseline.

checklist.name: instruction-8
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Declining trend:** Use the most recent sprint's figure rather than the average.

checklist.name: instruction-9
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Selected tickets** — `| Rank | Ticket | Estimate | Confidence | Notes |`
